title: A release adds secret-named constants, property reads and documented placeholders
intent: Synthetic regression distilled from a real-package false-positive sweep. Code that names its secrets rather than holding them: identifier-shaped constants (`token: "__ASTRO_ASSET_IMAGE__"`, `DATA_PROXY_SECRET: "MINIFLARE_PROXY_SECRET"`, Monaco tokenizer names), property reads (`password: parsedURL.password`, `token: n._authToken || n.token`, a value on the next line), `exports.Token = exports.Location` chains, JSDoc placeholders (`"<client-secret>"`, `<KEY>`, `XXXX` key bodies, `xxx/xxx/xxx` Slack hooks), PGP armor code, sample connection strings with placeholder logins, a minified string seam after `"password: "`, and an `AKIA` window inside an inlined base64 module must not read as secret content. All samples are inert FileRecord strings.
